sections.body: About the lawyer SERVANDO MCHAZLETT ABOUT SERVANDO J. MCHAZLETT Servando James McHazlett was raised in a small town in rural South Texas where he learned the values of hard work. Servando from a young age worked plowing fields on a tractor, bailing and hauling hay in the blistering heat of South Texas.Servando graduated from the University of Texas At San Antonio with a degree in History. Soon after that, Servando attended and graduated from the University of Oklahoma-College of Law. Servando began his law career as a solo-practitioner right away where he handled everything from Personal Injury litigation, Divorces, DTPA cases, Criminal, and a variety of other legal matters. Servando learned that his true passion was in representing people who did not ask to be injured, but were the victims of another person(s) negligence. Servando has prosecutor and defense experience, which has uniquely prepared him to take any Personal Injury case from trial to verdict. These days Servando almost exclusively handles Personal Injury cases. FROM SERVANDO J. My knowledge of trying numerous Drunk Driving Cases to a verdict of not guilty, has given me great insight on handling a death case where my client's loved one has been killed by a drunk driver. Contact Us I'll always be thankful for my broad legal experience because it comes in handy and applies in all facets of my personal injury practice.... If a police officer is called to your residence for domestic violence, and the officer determines that probable cause exists that family violence (an assault on your partner) has occurred from statements and a review of the physical evidence, the officer may arrest you if he/she believes that it is likely that you may commit further family violence.The facts of your case could make your potential jail term vary upward or downward depending on specific facts, like whether you have a prior conviction for an assault, whether bodily injury or serious bodily injury results. Other matters that will impact your outcome are whether a deadly weapon was used threatened to be used. Please note that in many instances, you may be eligible for probation. You will likely need to anticipate that a protective order will be filed against you. Call a criminal lawyer to discuss the many reasons why the issuance of a protective order could be devastating to your future. Contact Us

sections.body: BUS ACCIDENT LAWYER When you or a loved one has been seriously injured in a bus accident, it is important that you get an experienced accident attorney on your side right away. Bus companies and governmental agencies will have their people on site within minutes in order to protect their own interests. You need an honest, aggressive and committed injury attorney on your side, fighting for your rights and safeguarding your best interests.IF YOU HAVE BEEN INJURED OR IF YOU HAVE LOST A LOVED ONE IN A BUS ACCIDENT, PLEASE CONTACT OUR OFFICE FOR A BUS ACCIDENT LAWYER IMMEDIATELY. WHEN BUS ACCIDENTS OCCUR, THEY CAN RESULT IN SERIOUS INJURIES OR EVEN FATALITIES. VICTIMS OF BUS ACCIDENTS DO HAVE LEGAL RIGHTS. IF YOU HAVE BEEN INJURED IN A BUS ACCIDENT OR IF YOU HAVE LOST A LOVED ONE IN A BUS CRASH, PLEASE CONTACT THE Servando J. McHazlett Law OFFICE TO BETTER UNDERSTAND YOUR LEGAL RIGHTS AND OPTIONS. Types of Bus Accidents Bus accident claims can be complex, regardless of whether they involve school buses, commercial buses or transit buses run by cities or governmental agencies. In Texas, we have both public and private bus companies. It is important to understand the different types of bus accidents in order to better understand how the value or worth of your claim may be determined in Texas. SCHOOL BUS School bus drivers have the important responsibility of safely transporting our children. When school bus drivers operate negligently, they put the safety of our children at risk. When the negligence of a school bus driver causes an accident, the driver and his or her employer and the school district can be held liable. PUBLIC BUS Riding the bus to work and school is quickly becoming a way of life in the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. Riders depend on mass transit bus systems to get to their daily destinations. It is important that the transit authorities and governmental agencies that run these vehicles maintain them in good shape. Failure to do so can place their passengers in grave danger. TOUR BUS Tour bus accidents: Hundreds of Dallas residents, especially seniors, depend on tour buses to get to entertainment destinations such as resorts and casinos. Tour bus companies owe it to passengers to hire qualified and licensed drivers who have a clean record. Bus companies are also required to screen their drivers randomly for alcohol and drug use. DRIVER FATIGUE IS OFTEN A FACTOR IN TOUR BUS CRASHES. IT IS CRITICAL THAT DRIVERS RECEIVE SUFFICIENT REST BEFORE THEY GET ON THE ROAD. PROPER VEHICLE MAINTENANCE IS ALSO A MUST IN ORDER TO AVOID MAJOR INJURY CRASHES. Bus Accident Investigations Investigation of bus accidents can get extremely complex. Usually, local law enforcement agencies investigate these crashes. However, in the case of major bus crashes, the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) may get involved. These investigations often continue for months before a determination is made. Investigators will likely look into several factors as they examine the cause of the accident, injuries or fatalities such as:Seatbelt useCrashworthiness of the vehicleQualifications of the bus driverDriver impairmentFatigueDefective products such as brakes, tires, etc.Driver records and bus maintenance logs If you have been injured in a bus accident or if you have lost a loved one in a bus crash, please contact the Servando J. McHazlett Law Office to better understand your legal rights and options. Contact Us

sections.heading: 10 Most Important Tips When You Experience A Car Accident
sections.body: 1. When a car accident occurs, you should always call the police. If you are injured you should ask for ambulance assistance as well. Immediately after you are in a car accident you have to make sure you reach out to authorities. If you do not document the incident it can be very hard to prove it even happened after the fact. If the other driver has left the scene call the police immediately. Make sure to get a full police report to document the accident. 2. One of the best things you can do is take photos of the scene. This will provide sufficient evidence that the car accident occurred and the other drivers involved. If you do not have a phone or camera to take photos ask another person involved or someone nearby and to send them to you. Take pictures like all vehicles involved in the crash, license plates, the location where the damage occurred, and any other images you feel could help your case. If there are nearby road signs or markings try and have images of those in the same photos as the crash. 3. The next best thing to help you is going to be eye witness testimony. Try getting names and contact information of all witnesses who may have saw the car crash. Ask if they would be willing to talk with the police to tell them what they saw. 4. If you are experiencing any pain after the accident even if you do not see any external wounds please consult with a doctor immediately. If you wait to long to see a doctor it will look as if you have not been injured. 5. Make sure you file a No-Fault form with the car insurance company within 30 days of your accident. This will ensure that your medical bills are noted for medical treatment due to the car accident. If you do not file with in the time frame you may be liable for all medical bills associated with the accident. 6. However, there is an exception. If you were working at the time of the car accidents you will need to file Workers Compensation, in this case you must notify your employer as well as the representative of Workers Compensation within 30 days of the accident. We would advise to still file the No-Fault so you have covered all bases. 7. If a driver is working with municipality, the municipality is notified of the refund (Notice of Claim). If this notice is not filed within a timely manner you may lose the right of bringing a lawsuit to the driver or municipality. 8. Statute of Limitations does apply to car accidents in Texas. You have two years by Texas law to file your claim. This takes place the day the accident occurred or the day your property was damaged. 9. With the exception of your doctors and next of kin, as long as you have hired a lawyer, do not tell or tell anyone about the accident, and especially the insurance company. Insurance companies are not on your side and are more concerned with saving money, rather than paying an insurance premium. Any statements you give may be subsequently used against your interests. 10. Immediately contact Abogado Servando with the Servando J. McHazlett Law Firm.
